description: A shell script for testing Git repository behavior when it is unwritable, including setup and various test cases for git operations such as write-tree, commit, update-index, and add.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the preceding command fails.
